models_evaluated: AI triage device for pulmonary embolism on CT pulmonary angiography

links.outcome: Report turnaround time for PE-positive CTPA exams before vs after AI worklist prioritization
links.effect: Work-hour time savings 22.2 min (95% CI 5.85-38.6), significant (P=.004). Off-hour savings 2.82 min (-11.1 to 16.7), not significant (P=.345).
links.quote: Clinically observed time savings during work hours (22.2 [95% confidence interval: 5.85-38.6] min) were significant (P = .004), while off-hour (2.82 [-11.1 to 16.7] min) were not (P = .345).

unlisted_practices: Using computational workflow modeling (exam interarrival and radiologist read times from PACS) to predict expected time savings of AI triage before deployment
